build_scope: Peridigm 1.5.1 Dev; record actual binary SHA256 per run

rules.check: Canonical spec hash unchanged; compiled input semantically equal
rules.failure: block, require new confirmed case for physical changes

rules.check: SI units and dimensional named fields
rules.failure: ask for units; no ambiguous conversion

rules.check: Positive density and moduli; Elastic only; no damage/contact
2x1x1 point grid; positive cell volume 2 m^3; node sets 1,2 exist
Horizon 2 m includes the 2 m neighbor; exact qualified stencil only
rules.failure: new stencil needs qualification, not auto repair

rules.check: Free points, velocities +1/-1 m/s along x; no contact and no prescribed displacement

rules.source: Velocity-Verlet stability applied to two-point oscillator and source time settings
rules.check: omega*dt<2; dt=1e-5s; end=5e-5s; output every step
1 or 2 ranks; require every rank file, synchronized times and unique owned global IDs; compare merged fields to original reference
rules.failure: BLOCKED for other counts or incomplete shards
